mapper.select: SELECT id,event_type,aggregate_id,payload::text,attempts FROM outbox_events WHERE processed_at IS NULL AND available_at<=now() ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET processed_at=now() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE outbox_events SET attempts=attempts+1,available_at=now()+LEAST(300,power(2,LEAST(attempts+1,8))) * interval '1 second' WHERE id=#{id}
